obituaries.full_text:
CHESWOLD:  Clement (Ted) Carney, Jr. 66, of Cheswold died Saturday at his home after a short illness.

He was the owner and operator of Ted's Amusement Service here.

He is survived by his widow, Mrs. Henrietta Carney, and a daughter Henrietta C. Jeffries of Greensboro, NC.

Services will be Wednesday afternoon at 2 at the Matthews Funeral Homes in Smyrna.

Friends may call at the late residence tomorrow night from 7 to 9.

Clement Carney Jr. 
April 23, 
1966
